name: Warlock
fantasy: The Harrower: a gnome who struck a bargain with the crows of the Hollow. He rots foes from the inside, terrifies them into flight and drinks what is left, with Fiddlesticks' dread and hunger in fel green. A run takes him down one of three roads: Corruption (stacking curses), Fear (crowd control) or Drain (life drain that overflows into shields).

directions.name: Corruption
directions.desc: Damage over time, WoW-style: cheap curses that stack, spells that grow with every curse on a foe and how long it has been cursed, and a finisher that cashes them all in.

directions.name: Fear
directions.desc: Crowd control: terrify, bind and scatter. Feared foes flee, panic spreads, and the crows take whatever stops running.

directions.name: Drain
directions.desc: Life drain: beams and bolts that heal, healing past full life that hardens into a shield, and a feast at the end.

skills.name: Drain Life
skills.desc: Latch a green beam onto an enemy and pull the life out of it. The beam forks to up to 3 enemies near your target and everything it drains heals you. Hold Q to keep draining (costs mana each second).

skills.name: Blight Bolt
skills.desc: Hurl a howling skull of blight. It bursts where it lands and leaves a plague pool that rots enemies standing in it for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Soul Shackles
skills.desc: Chains of fel fire snap out to every enemy within 7 metres, damaging them and binding them in place for 2.5 seconds.

skills.name: Fel Covenant
skills.desc: Seal a pact with what waits beyond: +40% damage for 12 seconds, and Drain Life forks to two more enemies and heals twice as much.

skills.name: Corruption
skills.desc: Curse a foe up to 15 m away: 120% spell damage over 10 seconds. Cheap; casting it again refreshes it.

skills.name: Malediction
skills.desc: A fel bolt for 60% spell damage, +50% for every one of your curses on the target (up to five: 210%). Standing in your plague pool counts as a curse.

skills.name: Unending Rot
skills.desc: A curse for 12 seconds whose ticks grow 15% stronger for every second the foe has carried one of your curses without a break (up to four times as strong). A clean foe starts again.

skills.name: Festering Hex
skills.desc: A hex for 15 seconds: every 5 seconds it bursts for 80% spell damage and stuns the foe for half a second.

skills.name: Leeching Curse
skills.desc: A curse for 8 seconds: 100% spell damage over its life, and every tick heals you for half of what it dealt.

skills.name: Reckoning
skills.desc: The rare curse: for 6 seconds, each of its ticks deals as much as all your other curses on the foe tick for together.

skills.name: Terrify
skills.desc: Point at a foe within 8 m: it is frozen in terror for 1.5 seconds (a player flees for 1 second). Feared foes take 20% more from your spells.

skills.name: Scarecrow Effigy
skills.desc: Plant a scarecrow up to 12 m away for 8 seconds. The first three foes to come within 4 m are frightened for 1 second as its crows burst out cawing.

skills.name: Dark Wind
skills.desc: Send a crow at a foe: it bounces on to up to five enemies, 70% spell damage and a one-second slow each. Feared or bound foes take double.

skills.name: Crowstorm
skills.desc: Gather the crows, then blink up to 8 m: a storm of crows whirls 5 m round you for 5 seconds, 60% spell damage every half second, and everything caught as you land is feared for 1 second.

skills.name: Leech Bolt
skills.desc: A quick shadow bolt: 100% spell damage, and 30% of it heals you.

skills.name: Bountiful Harvest
skills.desc: Sweep a scythe of shadow round you (5 m): 140% spell damage, and each foe hit heals you 4% of your life (8% when it is the only one).

skills.name: Soul Feast
skills.desc: Channel for 3 seconds: beams to every foe within 7 m drain 50% spell damage a second from each. Healing past full life hardens into a shield, up to 30% of your life.
